stories.title: Putin vince senza avversari, pioggia di bombe ucraine sulla Russia

en.title: Putin wins without opponents, Ukrainian bombs rain on Russia
en.summary: Zelensky announces a meeting with Trump at the UN Assembly margins while Russian attacks target Kyiv and other cities, killing three children and a priest.

stories.title: Allianz Stadium, la curva Juve volta le spalle al silenzio per Mazzola

en.title: Allianz Stadium, Juve fans turn their backs on silence for Mazzola
en.summary: The Italian Football Federation prosecutor refers the case to the sports judge, and Juventus risks fines or sector closure following a stadium incident.

stories.title: USA-Houthi, allarme escalation. Trump rientra in anticipo da Camp David

en.title: USA-Houthi, escalation alarm. Trump returns early from Camp David
en.summary: The US president expresses options ranging from military action against Iran to diplomacy while Iran's economy contracts significantly and Israel conducts operations in Gaza.

stories.title: Berlino alla sinistra e Pomerania all'estrema destra, Merz: "Un disastro"

en.title: Berlin to the left and Pomerania to the far right, Merz: "A disaster"
en.summary: The Socialist Left party wins in Berlin's capital while the AfD prevails in the northeast, representing further electoral losses for the German chancellor's coalition.

stories.title: Elezioni in Russia, Putin incassa la vittoria: il suo partito è al 57%. Pioggia di droni sul voto

en.title: Elections in Russia, Putin secures victory: his party at 57%. Drone rain on voting
en.summary: Russia United won a majority in parliamentary elections, giving it control of the Duma. Opposition protests failed to gain traction amid a significant attack by Kyiv.

stories.title: Gli ultrà della Juve non rispettano il silenzio per Mazzola, la vergogna di dividersi sulla morte

en.title: Juventus ultras disrespect silence for Mazzola, shame in dividing over death
en.summary: Juventus supporters in the South Stand turned away during a moment of silence for Inter legend Mazzola, singing songs instead honoring deceased Juventus figures.

stories.title: Germania, le elezioni bocciano Merz. Meclemburgo all’AfD, Berlino alla Linke

en.title: Germany, elections reject Merz. Mecklenburg to AfD, Berlin to Linke
en.summary: Far-right AfD surged to 38% in Mecklenburg, surpassing socialists. Chancellor Merz's CDU narrowly avoided failure in Berlin, with Linke gaining support despite Merz refusing to resign.

stories.title: Trump rientra in anticipo, allerta Usa in Medio Oriente: “Devo decidere se far saltare l’Iran”

en.title: Trump returns early, US alert in Middle East: "I must decide whether to strike Iran"
en.summary: Trump left Camp David early as Washington warned of rapid escalation risks in the Middle East. Trump signaled openness to dialogue with Iran's president while keeping military options available.

stories.title: Pioggia di fuoco su Mosca, Putin rivince le elezioni. Zelensky sente Trump: “Ci vedremo a New York”

en.title: Fire rains on Moscow, Putin wins elections. Zelensky speaks with Trump: "We'll see each other in New York"
en.summary: Drones and missiles targeted Russia's capital as voting concluded for the Duma parliament. Zelensky announced plans to meet with Trump in New York.

stories.title: Tv, il partito Russia Unita di Putin vince le elezioni con il 49,4%

en.title: Tv, Putin's United Russia party wins election with 49.4%
en.summary: An exit poll from state broadcaster shows Putin's United Russia party winning the election with 49.4% of the vote.

stories.title: Germania, Afd arriva ancora prima nell’est e cancella la Cdu di Merz. Berlino salvata dalla sinistra

en.title: Germany, AfD comes first again in the east and eliminates Merz's CDU. Berlin saved by the left
en.summary: The far-right AfD won in Mecklenburg-Vorpommania but will not hold power, while the CDU failed to enter parliament in that state. The Left won decisively in Berlin as the chancellor pledged to continue reforms.

stories.title: Gli ultrà della Juve voltano le spalle nel minuto di silenzio per Mazzola. Ma lo Stadium applaude

en.title: Juventus ultras turn their backs during minute of silence for Mazzola. But the Stadium applauds
en.summary: Juventus supporters turned away during a minute of silence for Mazzola, though the stadium applauded. Chants honored other figures including Scirea, Fortunato, and Agnelli.

stories.title: Dal coworking alle case: Wao scommette sugli affitti flessibili

en.title: From coworking to homes: Wao bets on flexible rentals
en.summary: Wao, a company offering flexible rental options ranging from one night to one year for apartments, is expanding its business model beyond coworking spaces.

stories.title: «Silva Lab One”, laboratorio intelligente per gestire il bosco dei Monti Alburni

en.title: Silva Lab One, intelligent laboratory to manage the forest of Monti Alburni
en.summary: Silva Lab One is the first Natural Forest Laboratory established in the southern foothills of Monti Alburni within Cilento National Park, utilizing satellite technologies to manage the forest ecosystem.

stories.title: Purina investe 50 milioni sul sito di Portogruaro

en.title: Purina invests 50 million at Portogruaro site
en.summary: Purina's Portogruaro facility, marking its 40th anniversary, announces a new development phase with investment of 50 million euros for production of dry pet food for dogs and cats.

stories.title: «Revisione delle regole europee priorità per restare competitivi»

en.title: Review of European rules a priority to remain competitive
en.summary: Italian ceramic industry faces barriers to competitiveness despite European support, with first-half data from Confindustria Ceramica showing increased ceramic tile exports yet regulatory obstacles persist.

stories.title: Val di Fiemme e Cembra: autunno culturale, enogastronomico e wellness

en.title: Val di Fiemme and Cembra: cultural, gastronomic and wellness autumn
en.summary: Val di Fiemme and Cembra tourism boards have developed an autumn programme featuring indoor and outdoor activities plus events to attract visitors during off-season months.
